meta.description: Help open the health centre in Batack, Cameroon, and see what each donation is used for.

preversion: Site preview: figures are examples and no real payment is possible.

accueil.titre: Help Batack open its health centre
accueil.intro: The health centre building is there. Before it can welcome its first patients, it still needs a solid roof, electrical wiring and medical equipment. Each donation funds one of these steps, and you then see what it was used for.
accueil.projetsIntro: The village committee decides the order of the work. The amounts shown are examples until the COVIDEBA provides the real figures.
accueil.impactIntro: One amount, one specific use. These links are examples and will be replaced by real costs.

etapes.texte: Payment goes through Stripe, a secure payment provider. Your bank details never pass through this site.
The COVIDEBA chooses the next expense with a decision-support tool that always keeps a safety reserve.
Every significant expense is published here, with its invoice or a photo of the work.

aproposTexte: The COVIDEBA is the development committee of the village of Batack. It leads the village projects: drinking water, schools, health.

ConnectBatack 3 brings together the COVIDEBA, students from the Faculty of Engineering of Mons (UMONS) and the National Advanced School of Engineering of Yaoundé (ENSPY). The first two phases installed a solar microgrid and built the health centre building.
accueil.appelTexte: You can donate without creating an account, once or every month.
accueil.besoinTexte: First step of the works: protect the building before installing electricity and medical equipment.

dispensaire.description: First the roof, then the electrical wiring, then the laboratory and X-ray equipment.

batteries.description: The microgrid batteries power the health centre. They must be maintained, then replaced.

ecole.description: Pay a teacher so that the children have classes all year round.

eau.description: Extend the drinking water network that the COVIDEBA has started to build.

don.intro: Three steps, about two minutes. No account needed.

ponctuel.25: helps buy basic medicines for the health centre
ponctuel.100: helps pay a teacher's monthly salary
ponctuel.250: helps build the health centre roof

mensuel.10: helps buy basic medicines every month
mensuel.20: helps maintain the batteries every month
mensuel.35: helps pay a teacher every month
mensuel.50: helps the health centre works every month
